summary: TherapiShots reposition (mood-only UI + paid 15-min call) E2E PASSED. Backend: 37/37 pytest — added 3 new suites: TestTodayCallRecommendation (flags present on demo user; call_recommended=true when latest mood is heavy/anxious/frustrated; latest_group==='low'/'bright' matches latest entry), TestPsychologists.test_profiles_include_15min_call_and_short_price (every psychologist has '15-min Call' in session_types AND short_call_price < price), TestBookings.test_15min_call_charges_short_call_price (booking price==short_call_price, payment.provider=='mock'), TestBookings.test_video_session_charges_full_price (booking price==full p['price']). Regressions kept green: OTP request/verify (register+login), demo phone +919999900000, check-ins (multiple/day, unknown mood 400), /today, /insights.daily_moods(7), /pulse, /progress, psychologists CRUD+detail, cancel booking, auth enforcement across 6 protected endpoints. Frontend (Expo web mobile 390x844) logged in as +919999900000: (1) Today shows mood hero + today's entries + repeated-low banner + 'Suggested for you — Would talking to someone help? · Book a 15-min call' talk-card and NO sleep/steps/HR dashboard; (2) Book-a-call → /psychologists → tap Dr. Ananya Rao → session chip renders '15-min Call · ₹400', slot selected, Confirm & pay button renders '₹400', confirmation screen shows 'Dr. Ananya Rao · Sun 19 Jul · 10:00 · 15-min Call · ₹400 · Paid (mock)'; (3) Progress screen shows only Wellbeing Pulse (summary + Mood status), month count, Feel Map, Mood trend, Read your story CTA — NO sleep/steps/activity bar charts; (4) Insights renders 7-day mood strip (Su..Sa) + Consistent Pattern confidence cards; (5) My appointments lists the new booking with 'Cancel booking'. No blocking issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking Expo web deprecation warning about props.pointerEvents. No functional impact; still present but not from tested user code paths.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/today: call_recommended = repeated_low OR latest_mood_key in {heavy,anxious,frustrated}. Correct per spec. Also exposes latest_group for the UI. signals still returned in payload (harmless — UI just doesn't render it).

server.py /api/bookings: price selection guarded — session_type=='15-min Call' picks p['short_call_price'] with fallback to p['price'] if missing (defensive), else p['price']. session_type validated against p['session_types'] (400 otherwise). Payment stub clearly labelled provider=mock with MOCK- transaction id.
seed_psychologists() upserts by slug so short_call_price / '15-min Call' propagate on restart. Good — existing DBs get the new fields automatically.

server.py /api/progress still returns sleep_series/steps_series/activity_series arrays; the UI no longer renders these — dead payload weight. Optional cleanup: drop these from the response or hide behind a query param.

frontend psychologist/[id].tsx priceFor: uses (p?.short_call_price ?? p?.price) for '15-min Call' — matches backend logic exactly. Chip text and Confirm & pay button both read from priceFor() so the two prices stay in sync.
